# Dyson

> Dyson is a global technology company specializing in innovative vacuum cleaners, hair care appliances, and air treatment products with exclusive online shopping and support.

Dyson.com serves as the official e-commerce and support hub for Dyson's product portfolio, offering cordless vacuums with Hyperdymium motors, hair styling tools like the Airwrap and Supersonic, and air purification systems. The site provides product registration, warranty management through MyDyson, and access to refurbished products through the Dyson Outlet.

## Key Topics

- Cordless Vacuums
- V15 Detect

- Supersonic
- Hair Care

- HEPA Filtration
- MyDyson Account

- Motorbar Technology

- Commercial Products

## Shop Products

- [Official Dyson Website](https://www.dyson.com/en): Dyson homepage showcasing vacuum cleaners, hair care, and air treatment products
- [Vacuum Cleaners](https://www.dyson.com/vacuum-cleaners): Dyson vacuum cleaners including cordless, upright, and canister models
- [Cordless Vacuum Cleaners](https://www.dyson.com/vacuum-cleaners/cordless): Dyson cordless vacuums with Hyperdymium motor and HEPA filtration
- [Upright Vacuum Cleaners](https://www.dyson.com/vacuum-cleaners/uprights): Dyson upright and canister corded vacuum cleaners with Motorbar technology
- [Wet and Dry Vacuums](https://www.dyson.com/vacuum-cleaners/wet-dry): Dyson V15s Detect Submarine wet and dry vacuum with floor washing capability
- [Floor Cleaners](https://www.dyson.com/floor-cleaners): Dyson floor cleaning technology including PencilWash and wet-dry solutions
- [Best Sellers](https://www.dyson.com/best-sellers): Best-selling Dyson products including Airwrap and Airstrait hair care

## Account & Support

- [Contact Us](https://www.dyson.com/support/contact-us): Customer support contact page with chat, phone, and social media options

- [Product Registration](https://www.dyson.com/registration): Product registration and warranty activation for Dyson machines
- [My Dyson Profile](https://www.dyson.com/your-dyson/your-profile/keep-in-touch): MyDyson user profile management with warranty and support access
